text: おまえも　つかまえれば　いい　じゃん！

structure.jp: つかまえれば　いい

patterns.name: 〜ばいい
patterns.span: つかまえれば　いい
patterns.explanation: A verb ending in ば plus いい means 'it would be fine if you did', so it gives advice. つかまえれば　いい = 'you should just catch some'.

patterns.name: 〜じゃないか
patterns.explanation: じゃん is a casual short form of じゃないか, pushing the listener to agree, like 'isn't it?'. いい　じゃん = 'that's fine, isn't it!'
